title: Architecture Incubator — Hypothesis Cards and Proof Packets
central_diagnosis: The design space is expanding faster than the evidentiary foundation.
controlling_shift: Priority shifts from inventing to proving.

doctrine_freeze.rule: No new principles unless they solve a missing proof requirement.

must_answer_at_least_one: Which Phase 2 gate does this close?
Which constitutional mechanism depends on it?
exception_gate.if_none: Route to Architecture Incubator as a Hypothesis Card — do not mint a new principle, decision cluster, or public doctrine surface as if publishable.
exception_gate.approval: Exception requires explicit decision record citing the proof gap; cannot be justified by architectural appeal alone.

doctrine_freeze.strengthen_instead: Prefer raising confidence on existing principles and closing Burt proof steps over minting new principle IDs.

proof_packet.definition: A Proof Packet answers one proposition and, when finished, closes one gate or materially strengthens one claim/dossier.

three_layer_reviews_required_before_doct.name: Constitutional / legal evidence
questions: Could this exist within the Federal Constitution?

proof_packet.graduation_rule: Only after passing all three independent reviews may a Hypothesis Card graduate into publishable Constitutional Capitalism doctrine.
proof_packet.workflow_note: The three-layer retrofit (Burt step 2) is not a side checklist — it is the entire doctrine workflow for graduation.

biggest_risk.text: The biggest risk is not merely being wrong — it is building a beautiful internally consistent system that outsiders cannot believe because the evidentiary chain is not visible.
biggest_risk.audit_role: Forensic audit governance exists to prevent that failure mode.

hypothesis_cards.title: Community Prosperity Retirement Accounts
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Citizens can hold a fiduciary-capped local investment slice that aligns personal retirement security with community productive investment without imprudent concentration risk.
hypothesis_cards.note: Architecture surfaces may remain for capture; they are not manuscript-ready doctrine.

hypothesis_cards.title: Local Equity / Community Investment Units
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Resident-purchased or participation-earned Community Investment Units can finance productive local infrastructure with returns to citizen-owners under fiduciary boards.

hypothesis_cards.title: Family Business Continuity and Local Ownership Incentives
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Outcome-based incentives (Local Prosperity Scores, succession tools, patient capital) increase durable local wealth without punishing large firms or outside investment.

hypothesis_cards.title: Cooperative Capital and Cooperative Development Centers
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Practical cooperative development infrastructure raises worker/member ownership as a scalable option that recirculates value under transparent governance.
hypothesis_cards.note: NCEO ESOP and USDA ag-coop baselines are diagnosis context only — not a finished Proof Packet.

hypothesis_cards.title: Emergency Infrastructure as Prosperity Asset
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Treating fire/EMS/public health preparedness as prosperity infrastructure and rewarding measured resilience outcomes improves investment climate and household security.
evidence_needed: Legal authorities for reserves and mutual aid
hypothesis_cards.note: ISO PPC and NFPA volunteer baselines are diagnosis context only — not a finished Proof Packet.

hypothesis_cards.title: Local Food and Family Farm Wealth Engines
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Guaranteed institutional local markets, shared Food Utility infrastructure, and stewardship pay can make family farms engines of community wealth without micromanaging production.
evidence_needed: Food hub / mid-tier processing case studies
Counterarguments on cost, scale, and trade
hypothesis_cards.note: PP-FF-01 executive draft under OS 1.0 (UPD-068): verdict Qualifies, confidence Low. USDA baselines support narrow predicates only. Not publishable. Architecture unchanged. Contrary external literature still required before Complete.

hypothesis_cards.title: Collaborative Constitutional Review
hypothesis_cards.proposition: After proof, legal, modeling, manuscript, and education maturity, a peer-review journal–style scholarly system (expertise-tagged reviewers, typed reviews, Impact Requests) can strengthen the document without crowdsourcing or social-media dynamics.
evidence_needed: Legal review of public comment liability
hypothesis_cards.note: PENULTIMATE LAYER (Phase 8). Peer-review journal model + Impact Requests under CC-DEC-098. Do not build in Phase 2. True capstone is HYP-118 Understand layer (Phase 9).

hypothesis_cards.title: Constitutional Capitalism Systems Intelligence Engine
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A RedDirt-connected whole-system impact engine can let users change inputs and see direct, indirect, delayed, distributional, and legal/tradeoff effects across the Constitutional Capitalism graph — with simulations labeled as scenario estimates and humans retaining all authority over doctrine and publication.
hypothesis_cards.note: TRUE CAPSTONE Phase 9. Architecture only. Does not raise modeling % until real models exist.

hypothesis_cards.title: Impact Requests → System Impact Review
hypothesis_cards.proposition: When a Phase 8 reviewer submits an Impact Request (e.g., change a policy variable), the Phase 9 Systems Intelligence Engine can return a structured System Impact Review — principles, claims, evidence packets, legal questions, variables, conflicts, simulation scenarios, and confidence — without accepting or rejecting the change.
evidence_needed: Human-in-the-loop approval before any doctrine change
Refusal rules when evidence is insufficient
hypothesis_cards.note: Bridge capability. Requires Phase 8 review platform + Phase 9 engine. Not built in Phase 2.

hypothesis_cards.title: Policy Diff Analysis
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A proposed manuscript or doctrine change can be analyzed as a framework-wide diff — counting and explaining affected doctrine items, principles, evidence packets, legal analyses, educational modules, and simulations — so unintended consequences are visible before acceptance.
evidence_needed: Graph edge completeness for doctrine↔claim↔source↔chapter links
Diff presentation UX without false precision
Human review gate before any accepted change
Explainability fields on every diff conclusion
hypothesis_cards.note: Phase 9 capability under roadmap freeze. Do not build in Phase 2.

hypothesis_cards.title: Lewisville Comprehensive Community Case Study
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A real community facing a major economic transition can serve as the first Living Community Laboratory — a Comprehensive Community Case Study that tests how multiple Constitutional Capitalism doctrines interact — provided the work remains investigative (not a validation pilot) and baseline facts are registered before analysis.
evidence_needed: Verified community baseline from registered sources
Scoped description of economic transition (e.g., lithium) without advocacy framing
Systems map of interacting local domains
Scenario assumptions published and labeled as estimates
Lessons feeding Supports/Qualifies/Contradicts for affected doctrines
hypothesis_cards.note: Not a pilot. Not doctrine. Does not raise modeling %. Priority remains PP-FF-01.

hypothesis_cards.title: Rose Bud Rural Education and Farm Community Laboratory
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A rural public school district could become a regional education, agriculture, and skilled-trades hub that attracts students and strengthens local farms and economy — but only if enrollment economics, statutory authority (including Arkansas LEARNS), funding eligibility, transportation, graduated housing, and community impacts are honestly researched. Status: architecture scaffold only; unproven.
evidence_needed: Arkansas LEARNS / school-choice / funding statute map
Marginal revenue vs marginal cost model for additional students
USDA and non-USDA funding eligibility matrix (operations vs capital)
Community demand and safeguarding capacity for any housing stage
hypothesis_cards.note: Not a pilot. Not a funding claim. Complements HYP-121 Lewisville. Priority remains PP-FF-01.

hypothesis_cards.title: Rural Prosperity Campus Model
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A rural public education system can become the coordinating institution for rebuilding a regional food economy while improving education, workforce development, family farm profitability, and community prosperity — with the high school as anchor of a multi-layer ecosystem (farms, food chain, business cluster, cooperatives, food security, student enterprises, graduate transition) — without compromising its primary educational mission. Unproven; research only.
evidence_needed: Educational outcome measures for campus-style models
Financial sustainability without presumed grant stacks
hypothesis_cards.note: Not doctrine. Linked to Rose Bud LCL. Priority remains PP-FF-01.

hypothesis_cards.title: Distributed Arkansas Prosperity Network
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Specialized regional living laboratories can form a connected, non-identical statewide network sharing curriculum, research, and lessons — each hub excellent at something different (agriculture, resource wealth, forestry, manufacturing, healthcare, etc.).
evidence_needed: Governance of shared curriculum without homogenizing communities
hypothesis_cards.note: Depends on successful individual LCL case methodology. Not statewide doctrine.

hypothesis_cards.title: Local Democratic Campaign-Finance System
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Campaign-finance rules can make political power substantially more local, transparent, citizen-driven, and competitive without allowing government to determine which political voices may be heard.
evidence_needed: Independent expenditure / outside-spending share and concentration
Contested vs uncontested and incumbent/challenger finance gaps
AR state-race finance analogues (Open States + AR sources; gap-flagged)
Congress.gov reform/amendment study objects (Track B; not endorsement)
Journalism coverage covariates via existing civic-information coding
hypothesis_cards.note: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS under CC-DEC-105. Track A (current First Amendment doctrine) and Track B (comparative constitutional architecture research). Converges with journalism module. CC-CLAIM-003 remains NEE. No ingest in registration slice.

hypothesis_cards.title: Distributed Civic Commons
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A society organized through dense, voluntary, locally rooted and networked civic institutions may increase participation, trust, accountability, community problem-solving and democratic resilience by giving citizens repeated opportunities to exercise meaningful agency over the institutions affecting their lives.
evidence_needed: Civic association density / social-capital comparative synthesis
Participatory budgeting and neighborhood agency case outcomes
Neighborhood council / precinct / volunteer-fire / mutual-aid / cooperative lessons
Citizen assembly and digital civic-network mixed results
Failure modes: capture, exclusion, burnout, factionalism, conformity pressure
Civic Record design boundaries that never condition political rights
Arkansas Living Community Laboratory granularity fieldwork
hypothesis_cards.hard_boundary: Participation as civic duty; political rights must never depend on participation
hypothesis_cards.note: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS under CC-DEC-106. Cultural layer research only — no new principle. Converges with journalism module and HYP-125. Study failure modes. Structural sequence county NASS → FRED/BEA unchanged.

hypothesis_cards.title: Age-16 Local Suffrage (empirical track)
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Under identifiable institutional conditions — especially local decision-making, civic education, and dense civic networks — extending suffrage to 16- and 17-year-olds for local elections may strengthen meaningful and durable civic participation without converting civic preparation into a franchise gate.
evidence_needed: Maryland municipal election-record inventory (Takoma Park, Greenbelt, others, matched controls)
Newark failure-mode documentation with overall-turnout context
Brattleboro town vs school-district ballot split
Austria capability literature; Scotland/Wales repeated-cycle covariates
hypothesis_cards.note: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS under CC-DEC-107. Local first. Four propositions may graduate separately. Newark contrary evidence not hidden. Does not displace FRED/BEA.

hypothesis_cards.title: Civic Engagement and Community Structure
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Community-structure conditions (ownership, farms, banking, healthcare access, journalism, education, demography) consistently co-vary with civic engagement patterns (turnout level, stability, persistence); mapping what travels together — descriptively first — is required before testing HYP-125/126/127 without misattributing outcomes to single instruments.
evidence_needed: VAP/registered turnout rates (presidential votes now bound; denominators NEE)
Derived trend, volatility, persistence on comparable election types
ACS/FDIC/HRSA county joins to deepen longitudinal layer
Descriptive co-travel maps with alternative explanations
Adult civic baselines as control context for HYP-127
hypothesis_cards.note: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS under CC-DEC-108. CC-DEC-117 added County×Year layer v1 (correlation first). Community Health Index exploratory only — not baseline. Does not displace definition-locks.

hypothesis_cards.title: Arkansas Transition Pathway
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Arkansas can move power, ownership, capability, and decision-making closer to ordinary people through a sequenced four-layer pathway — immediate buildable programs under existing law, community wealth systems, civic infrastructure between elections, and longer-horizon structural reform — piloted in one school district, town, or county and measured against comparable communities before expansion, without breaking constitutional protections, markets, or civil liberties.
evidence_needed: First intervention packets with full legal/funding/institution/outcome/failure/expansion fields
Implementation ladder gates (pilot → result → replication → county → regional → statewide)
LEARNS / CTE / magnet / apprenticeship authority map
Candidate site plus matched comparable communities
Graduate outcome measurement bundle (certs, apprenticeships, ownership, leadership)
Cooperative food / grocery entity and capital-pool legal boundaries
Participatory budgeting and assembly authority under local law
Layer-4 evidence/legal gates for campaign finance, labor, education, healthcare
Pre-registered comparable-community evaluation protocol before expansion
hypothesis_cards.note: KEEP_AS_RESEARCH_FRAMEWORK under CC-DEC-109; deepened under CC-DEC-114 with implementation ladder + intervention packets. Sequences HYP-122–128. Layer-1 programs ≠ validation of whole framework. Layer-4 research-bound. Does not displace definition-locks.

hypothesis_cards.title: Arkansas Strategic Capacity Audit
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Arkansas can map critical professions, industries, and technical capacities it needs but does not currently educate or train enough people for — then compare current university, community-college, trade, apprenticeship, and extension capacity against missing and strategic capacity — so Constitutional Capitalism transition work reduces dependency by building local capability rather than importing every scarce skill.
evidence_needed: Official ADHE / campus / CTE / apprenticeship / extension program catalogs
Has → needs → imports → lacks → buildable matrix for priority sectors
Join of existing shortage dials without proxy abuse
Sector coverage: education, healthcare, agriculture, energy, manufacturing, technology, infrastructure, skilled trades, public services
Strategic add-list linked to HYP-129 Layer-1 magnet hub design
hypothesis_cards.note: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS under CC-DEC-112; capability-map chain locked under CC-DEC-114. Tier-1 parallel track. Registration only — no capacity census executed. Does not displace definition-locks.

hypothesis_cards.title: Prosperity-Based Revenue Replacement System
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Arkansas can eventually retire individual income tax and property tax only if it first inventories every current revenue source and legal dependency, then builds dual State and Community Prosperity Revenue Ledgers where replacement streams that grow with prosperity are demonstrably online — ring-fenced in a Tax Retirement Fund — before staged tax reductions, without shifting the same burden onto ordinary people through a single regressive swap and without treating unmodeled public-wealth returns as replacement dollars.
hypothesis_cards.status: Research framework — not doctrine — public-income engines architected; $0 counted
evidence_needed: Use + Depletion incremental cash-flow models (beyond already-earmarked streams)
Value Capture / Enterprise ownership templates with legal authority
Prosperity Fund capital path (corpus, returns, years-to-scale)
District-AV-weighted school debt dollars; municipal bond/general split
hypothesis_cards.note: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS. CC-DEC-127: ten public-income engines; TAX→FEE/RENT/ROYALTY→RETURN; no discriminatory export taxes; $0 counted toward ~$7.23B until cash-flow models.

website_node.role: Governing capture surface for Hypothesis Cards — not a public doctrine marketing page

do_not: Treat Architecture Candidate pages as publishable doctrine
Claim modeling or legal progress without actual work

derivation_test: New ideas must derive from the First Principle and Ten Foundational Axioms (CC-DEC-095) or remain Hypothesis Cards.

architecture_roadmap_freeze.rule: Architecture chapter closed. Default next work is proof. Architectural proposals must clear the CC-DEC-101 threshold gate.
threshold_questions: What deficiency in the current architecture does this solve?
Why can't the existing architecture accommodate it?
Which decisions would need to be revisited?
What new complexity does it introduce?
Does it strengthen or weaken Constitutional Symmetry?

living_community_laboratories.rule: Multi-doctrine community case studies. Distinct from proof packets. Case study ≠ pilot.
